title: Ericsson and LG Uplus to advance network-based voice AI and AI-native network evolution
summary: Ericsson and LG Uplus will collaborate to explore network-based voice AI global business opportunities and accelerate AI-native network transformation to create new customer experiences, improve operational efficiency, and drive future growth in the AI era. Strategic partnership combines LG Uplus’s voice AI innovation capabilities and Ericsson’s global network technology leadership. Collaboration aims to bring voice AI beyond app-based boundaries and into communications service provider networks. The partnership will help build intelligent and programmable networks that accelerate innovation and enable the next generation of AI-driven services.
